hash_rule: sha256 of json.dumps(<this object>, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')), as grader.canonical_sha256. grader_v4.py hard-codes it and refuses to run on mismatch.
registration_basis: Protocol v1's D1_prior_regression entry says returning minutes is NOT in its grid for lack of player data and must be re-registered by amendment if a lane supplies it. Lane P supplied it (commits 8a7b8953, 00cf1b52, a3c8c3ca); this addendum is that re-registration, plus an availability candidate.

pinned_inputs_sha256.rule: grader_v4 re-hashes the feature table and the feature builder on every call and refuses on mismatch. A rebuilt table is a new addendum.

feature_table.schema: ncaab-pit-player-features-v1, one row per (event_id, team side); definitions in scripts/ncaab_research/player_features_261121.md
feature_table.pit_rule: a row uses only the team's player boxes from games on an EARLIER Eastern date, plus the complete previous season; the game's own box is never an input
feature_table.box_gate: a team-game box is usable only if player points sum to the team score, minutes are within 5 of 200 + 25 per OT period, every player with minutes has an athlete id, and no athlete id appears on both teams; otherwise the team-game counts as having no box (fail closed, the feature goes null rather than reading DNP lines as absences)
feature_table.transfers: joined on ESPN athlete id only. About 7% of season-to-season transfers carry a new ESPN id and therefore count as newcomers (lane P audit: 359 two-id names vs 4803 id-stable team changes). Disclosed, not corrected; a name crosswalk would be a new addendum.
feature_table.season_2022_rows: 2021-22 (season year 2022) is a sealed confirmation season. Its feature rows are never fit on and never scored in development. Its boxes enter development only as the prior-season input to 2023 continuity / returning-production features.

multiplicity.counting_rule: As v3: one K per statistic family; K = the previous K of the family + every v4 grid entry that produces a statistic of that family. Both v4 entries are mean-family spread candidates and also produce cover and moneyline statistics, so those families are charged too. K never decreases; a withdrawn or unread entry keeps its charge.

derivation.total: unchanged 26 (v4 candidates carry served v6 totals or none)
derivation.moneyline: v1 14 + P1 + P2 = 16 (the A_ml_w0 confirmation read was its own registered window and is not re-charged here)

multiplicity.adjusted_interval: unchanged: percentile day-cluster bootstrap (4000 resamples, seed 17, Eastern game-day clusters, grader._boot) at alpha = 0.025 / K per tail; the plain 95% interval is reported alongside
multiplicity.rereads: One logged read per grid name per window. A second, different predictions file under the same grid name and window gets REREAD_NO_VERDICT (grader_v4 checks read_log.jsonl before scoring).

windows.development: unchanged: season years 2023-2026, leave-one-season-out, espn_archive closing lines (ncaab-espn-lines-rule-1), the v1 cohort (D1-vs-D1 with a closing spread line). Season year >= 2027 or Eastern date >= 2026-07-01 is refused before any score or line is read. Every free parameter of a fold is fit on that fold's three training seasons among 2023-2026 only.

confirmation.lines: addendum v2's confirmation line source (espn_backfill_261120), unchanged
confirmation.player_data: player boxes for season years 2014-2021 do not exist yet. They are fetched ONLY if a v4 candidate is DEV_ELIGIBLE, with scripts/backfill_ncaab_player_boxes.py at the pinned hash (season list extended, nothing else), and the feature table for 2015-2022 is built with player_features_261121.py at the pinned hash (season list extended, nothing else). 2014 and 2021 are prior-season inputs only.
confirmation.season_usability: decided OUTCOME-FREE before the read: a confirmation season counts only if at least 85% of its D1 team-games pass the box gate. Seasons below 85% are dropped and listed on the card.
confirmation.coefficients: one fit on all four development seasons 2023-2026, frozen, then applied to the confirmation seasons. No refit on confirmation data.
confirmation.pass_rule: the primary statistic (spread_corr_delta_vs_v7) with a plain one-sided 95% bound above 0, pooled over the usable confirmation seasons, one read per candidate (v1 beats_v7 rule).
confirmation.unavailable: if fewer than 3 confirmation seasons are usable, or the confirmation boxes cannot be fetched, the verdict is CONFIRMATION_UNAVAILABLE and the candidate is judged only on the locked 2026-27 forward window as a shadow challenger under a new pin.

P1_player_availability.spec: mu = v7_mu + b1 * dA + b2 * dL, where dA = avail_top7_prev1(home) - avail_top7_prev1(away) and dL = top7_minutes_share_out_3plus(home) - top7_minutes_share_out_3plus(away). b1, b2 by OLS with no intercept on the training seasons' cohort rows where all four inputs are non-null, target = actual margin - v7_mu. scale_margin and dist = v7's (unchanged). If any of the four inputs is null for a game, the adjustment is 0 (the game is predicted by v7).

P2_returning_production_early.spec: mu = v7_mu + w(s) * (c1 * dR + c2 * dG), where dR = (ret_gmsc_share_same + ret_gmsc_share_transfer_in)(home) - (same)(away), dG = prior_gmsc40_cur_weighted(home) - prior_gmsc40_cur_weighted(away), s = the archive's games_played_min (point in time) and w(s) = max(0, 1 - s / 10), fixed. c1, c2 by OLS with no intercept on the training seasons' cohort rows with w(s) > 0 and all inputs non-null, regressor columns w*dR and w*dG, target = actual margin - v7_mu. scale_margin and dist = v7's. Null inputs or w(s) = 0 give adjustment 0 (v7).
P2_returning_production_early.variant_selection: none: the decay (10 games, linear) is fixed here, not tuned

baseline_v7_mu: v7_mu is the development baseline's v7_served mean exactly as grader.baseline_predictions gives it (m5r leave-one-season-out predictions for 2023 and 2024, served constants for 2025 and 2026); only its prediction columns are read, outcomes only as the training-fold target.
null_rule: Null feature rows fall back to v7 (adjustment 0), so every cohort game is predicted and the 99% coverage rule is met. The verdict is on the FULL cohort. Reported alongside, with no verdict: the same paired statistics restricted to games whose adjustment is non-zero, and the share of such games per season.

acceptance.dev: v1 mean_family rule with K = 25: DEV_ELIGIBLE iff (i) spread_corr_delta_vs_v7 K-adjusted lower bound > 0, (ii) margin_rmse_delta_vs_v7 point <= 0, (iii) the pooled 2025+2026 folds' corr delta point > 0, (iv) no leak flag (v1 leak_flags unchanged, plus refusal if a feature row's source hash mismatches or a predicted season appears among its fit seasons), (v) coverage >= 99% in every held-out season.
acceptance.beats_v7: v1 rule unchanged: only a DEV_ELIGIBLE candidate that then passes the confirmation read beats v7; it may then be registered as a shadow challenger under a new pin. Promotion stays a separate operator decision through model_promotion.

moneyline_disclosure: Live NCAAB moneyline has served ncaab-moneyline-v7m (pure margin probability) since 2026-11-21 (commit e865f518). The pinned development baseline is still the v7 0.5 Elo blend. v4 candidates submit p_home_ml = grader.served_ml_blend(event_ids, mu, scale, dist) so the moneyline secondaries compare like with like against that baseline. Moneyline is not a v4 primary.
reproduction_gate: Before any v4 candidate is scored, grader_v4 must reproduce the baseline scorecard's v7_served spread block from outputs/ncaab/research_261120/baseline_scorecard.json at v1's K (21): n, RMSE, bias, slope and CI, corr, rule-1 MSE delta and K-adjusted CI, cover log loss, to the scorecard's printed precision. A miss aborts. Logged in read_log.jsonl as BASELINE_SPREAD_REPRO_V4; adds no K.
plumbing: Each candidate is first scored with --shuffle-seed (outcomes shuffled within season, not logged, no number means anything). Then exactly one logged read per grid name.

submission.schema: grader.py submission schema (event_id, season, game_date, home_team, away_team, neutral, mu_margin, scale_margin, dist, games_played_min, p_home_ml). No totals fields.
submission.sidecar: candidate, grid_name (P1_player_availability or P2_returning_production_early), protocol_sha256 (v1), addendum_v4_sha256, code_sha256, fit_seasons_by_predicted_season (the predicted season may never appear; 2022 may never appear), history_cutoff 'strictly before Eastern midnight of the game day', data_sources with sha256 (must include the pinned feature table)

unchanged: protocol v1, addenda v2 and v3 (grids, K, verdicts, reads already done), the lock, the line rule, the bootstrap constants, the rule-1 machinery, no shrink-toward-the-market candidate (the market line never enters a candidate's inputs or targets)
